findings.text: The iPhone add-to-Home-Screen steps end with "Tap Allow one notification a week, then Allow" (public/join/copy.js:63), but an iOS Home Screen app has its own cookie jar, separate from Safari. A person who opens it from the Home Screen is signed out and sees Continue with Google first. Say "sign in again, then tap Allow" (and check that GIS/FedCM signs in inside the standalone app). Otherwise the iOS half of the owner's "sign in, then turn on notifications" ask breaks at its last step.

Brief decision 11 (find the past Durable Object + WebSocket work for documents and note in the auth proposal how a per-user live connection would attach) is not done: `mastermind-forms/auth/proposal.md` has no socket or live-connection note, and the diff touches nothing for it.

Real push to a real browser was never achieved on staging. `join/shots/staging-p-3-after-allow-400.png` shows permission granted, but subscription (browser) false and subscription (server) false, with the state stuck on allow. The later commit 3bd0f7fcc0 ("time limit on the push subscribe") is on worktree/qf-1 but not in this diff.patch, so it was not reviewed. Brief 8 asks to "test with a real Chrome subscription on the PC": that is still open, and task.jsonl should say so plainly rather than "/api/auth/test 200".
A stale comment at worker/index.js:92 (the `logout-all` route): it still says "one counter, no sessions table", but the route now also ends every `sessions` row (diff line 1235).

A fresh agent can't continue from the task folder alone. There is no `requirements.md` at its top (the brief is `brief.md`). plan.md decision 1 still says "a framework page built from ux/Auth", although task.jsonl records the switch to a standalone index.html. task.jsonl has no closing outcome. The shots (`join/shots/`) exist only on worktree/qf-1. Update plan.md decision 1, close the task with an outcome, and merge or link the shots.

A Copy link or Share in the in-app card copies `location.href` (public/join/Join.js:471). In test mode that URL carries `?test=<TEST_LOGIN_KEY>`, so sharing the page from a test session publishes the staging test key. Strip the `test` param from the shared URL.

`Backend` has no `login()`: public/join/Join.js:377 calls `this.backend.login(user)` whenever GoogleButton fires a mock sign-in. That happens on any stage where `/api` answers but `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` is empty (production today). The result is a TypeError, not a sign-in. `Backend.detect()` could fall back to the mock when `client_id` is empty.

`Reset everything` runs `localStorage.clear()` (Join.js:550), which wipes every app's local state on staging.lew42.com, not only /join/'s keys (`join-mock`, `join-google-email`). Debug only, but worth narrowing.

Small dead code in Join.js: `this.$sound_slot` (line 333) is never read; render() destructures an unused `copy` (line 360); `copy_err` (line 555) just returns `err.message`. The "Not working?" sheet renders an empty `<h2>` (`this.sheet("", …)`, line 484).
`Join` is a new class with no `Join.test.mjs` (agents.md law 12). `shoot.mjs` walks the flow headless, so this may be acceptable, but say so in public/join/readme.md.
